rubric.correctness: Can the student explain FCFS, SJF, Round Robin, and Priority scheduling algorithms and calculate average waiting time?
rubric.depth: Does the student understand context switching overhead, CPU burst prediction, multilevel feedback queues, and real-time scheduling?
rubric.tradeoffAwareness: What are the starvation risks with priority scheduling? When is preemptive vs non-preemptive scheduling preferred?
rubric.realWorldApplicability: Can the student analyse how Linux CFS scheduler works and why it benefits interactive workloads over batch jobs?

rubric.correctness: Can the student explain paging, segmentation, TLB, page replacement algorithms (LRU, CLOCK), and page faults?
rubric.depth: Does the student understand demand paging, working set model, thrashing, and memory-mapped files?
rubric.tradeoffAwareness: Fixed vs variable partitioning trade-offs? How does page size affect TLB hit rate and internal fragmentation?
rubric.realWorldApplicability: Can the student diagnose a memory leak or thrashing scenario in a production JVM application?

rubric.correctness: Can the student explain the TCP three-way handshake, flow control (sliding window), congestion control (AIMD), and DNS resolution?
rubric.depth: Does the student understand TCP vs UDP trade-offs, HTTP/2 multiplexing, TLS handshake, and NAT traversal?
rubric.tradeoffAwareness: When is UDP preferred over TCP (video streaming, gaming)? How does head-of-line blocking affect HTTP/1.1?
rubric.realWorldApplicability: Can the student debug a latency issue in a microservice using Wireshark captures and TCP state diagrams?

rubric.correctness: Can the student define 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF and identify functional dependencies and candidate keys?
rubric.depth: Does the student understand denormalisation trade-offs, index design (B-tree vs hash), MVCC, and ACID properties?
rubric.tradeoffAwareness: When to denormalise for read performance vs maintain normalisation for write integrity?
rubric.realWorldApplicability: Can the student design a normalised schema for a hospital records system and identify which queries need composite indexes?

rubric.correctness: Can the student explain mutex, semaphore, monitors, deadlock conditions (Coffman), and detection/prevention?
rubric.depth: Does the student understand race conditions, memory models (happens-before), lock-free data structures, and actor model?
rubric.tradeoffAwareness: Optimistic vs pessimistic locking? When are lock-free algorithms worth the complexity cost?
rubric.realWorldApplicability: Can the student identify a deadlock in a multi-threaded Java service and redesign the locking protocol to prevent it?
